# dsh-omni-browser

> **Control a real browser — and take the whole page with you.**
> 16 `omni_*` tools that drive Chro
me/Edge over CDP *and* capture everything a page is as one self-contained evidence folder.
Most browser plugins in the DSH marketplace give you a remote control. `dsh-omni-browser` gives you
a remote control **plus a forensic camera**: DOM, accessibility tree, HAR with response bodies, cons
ole log, cookies/storage, full-page screenshots, PDF and a screencast — all written into one timesta
mped folder with a manifest.
No npm dependencies, no bundled Chromium, no cloud service. It starts the Chrome you already have an
ies, no bundled Chromium, no cloud service. It starts the Chrome you already have and talks raw CDP.
## Why another browser plugin?
| | Control-only plugins | **dsh-omni-browser** |

| Click / type / navigate | ✅ | ✅ |
| Read DOM & text | ✅ | ✅ |
| Accessibility tree with stable ref

s | sometimes | ✅ `ax:<backend-node-id>` |
| HAR 1.2 **with response bodies** | ❌ | ✅ |
| Console +

uncaught exceptions | sometimes | ✅ |
| Cookies / localStorage / IndexedDB / CacheStorage / service

workers | ❌ | ✅ |
| Full-page screenshot + element screenshot + PDF | partly | ✅ |
| Screencast fram

es of what actually happened | ❌ | ✅ |
| One-call **evidence bundle** + manifest | ❌ | ✅ `omni_captu

re` |
| Bounded multi-page **harvest** | ❌ | ✅ `omni_harvest` |
Use it for: agent research on real sites, bug reports that must be reproducible, compliance/archival
snapshots, scraping where you need the network truth (not just the rendered text), and "why did the
page show that?" debugging.

## The 16 tools
| Tool | What it does |
| `omni_status` | Is Chrome running, which tabs, version, profile. `action: launch \| close \| resta

rt` |
| `omni_open` | Open a URL (reuse tab or `newTab`), wait for `load`/`domcontentloaded`/`networ

kidle` |
| `omni_tabs` | `list` / `new` / `close` / `activate` |
| `omni_page` | Read the page: `sna

pshot`, `text`, `html`, `ax`, `links`, `forms`, `meta`, `outline`, `frames`, `resources` |
| `omni_a
ct` | `click`, `dblclick`, `hover`, `focus`, `type`, `press`, `scroll`, `select`, `check`, `uncheck`

, `upload`, `drag`, `wait`, `back`, `forward`, `reload` — real input events |
| `omni_eval` | Evalua

te JS in the page, get JSON back |
| `omni_screenshot` | `viewport` / `fullpage` / `element` / `clip

` → real file |
| `omni_pdf` | Print current page to PDF |
| `omni_network` | `list`, `body` (one re

sponse body), `har`, `stats`, `save`, `clear` |
| `omni_console` | `list` / `clear` / `save` console

+ exceptions |
| `omni_storage` | `all`, `cookies`, `local`, `session`, `indexeddb`, `cache`, `sw`,

`save` |
| `omni_capture` | **one-call evidence bundle** |
| `omni_harvest` | bounded crawl, one bu

ndle per page |
| `omni_record` | screencast the tab for N seconds → JPEG frames + manifest |
| `omn

i_download` | `enable` (set download dir), `wait`, `list` |
| `omni_perf` | `metrics`, `trace`, `cov
erage`, `resources` |
Element targets accept `{ "selector": "#id" }`, `{ "text": "Sign in" }`, `{ "ref": "ax:1234" }` (fro
m `omni_page mode=ax`) or `{ "x": 100, "y": 200 }`.
## Configuration
All optional — set via the plugin `config` in `cordis.patch.yml`, or environment variables:
| Env | Meaning | Default |

| `OMNI_CHROME_PATH` | Browser executable | auto-detect Chrome/Edge/Chromium |
| `OMNI_PORT` | CDP p

ort (`0` = pick a free port) | `0` |
| `OMNI_HEADLESS` | `1` / `0` | `1` |
| `OMNI_USER_DATA_DIR` |

Browser profile directory | `~/.dsh/omni-browser/profile-<DSH profile>` |
| `OMNI_OUTPUT_DIR` | Wher

e captures go | `<cwd>/omni-capture/<timestamp>/` |
| `OMNI_HOME` | Plugin data home | `~/.dsh/omni-

go | `<cwd>/omni-capture/<timestamp>/` |
| `OMNI_HOME` | Plugin data home | `~/.dsh/omni-browser` |
The plugin uses its **own browser profile**, so it never touches your personal Chrome session. Cooki
es you log into inside the managed browser persist between runs (same profile directory).
## Privacy & safety
- Captures may contain **secrets** (session cookies, tokens in headers, page content). Treat `omni-c
apture/` as sensitive data. Use `includeValues: false` with `omni_storage` to keep keys but redact v

alues.
- The browser profile is isolated by default, but anything you type into it is real — use a d

edicated account for risky automation.
- This tool is for sites you are allowed to access. It is not
a scraping-as-a-service bypass and does not solve CAPTCHAs.
